section.8: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from hunger, for it is an evil bed-fellow; and I seek refuge in Thee from treachery, for it is an evil hidden trait
